rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The Chief Cabinet Secretary's press record of the morning of 2 June 2010 says that at 10:00 that day, at the Democratic Party's joint meeting of members of both Houses, a message from 鳩山代表 announced that he would resign as Prime Minister and as party leader (総理大臣、並びに党代表を辞する).

locator.section: 平成22年6月2日（水）午前 — 臨時閣議の開催について, sentence 1

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The same record says that the government would carry on as before until the new head of government (新しい首班) was chosen, that an extraordinary cabinet meeting would decide to that effect that day, and that the Hatoyama coalition cabinet (鳩山連立内閣) would act without a gap until the next head was chosen.
